body:
I take a lot of daily vitamins and supplements. I've been taking Ambien almost every night and had taken some that morning, probably 3 to 5 hours prior. Hadn't eaten since the night before (at least 8 hours). I have been taking 150 mg Wellbutrin (bupropion) for a week and the first 300 mg dose last night.
(NOTE: DON'T MIX AN MAOI WITH ANY KIND OF REUPTAKE INHIBITOR. Mixing it with an SSRI can cause serotonin syndrome and mixing it with a SNRI or DNRI can cause a hypertensive crisis. I was OK, but it was poor judgement on my part and next time I'm going to let it clear my system for a few days prior.)
A few months ago, I extracted DMT from mimosa hostilis root bark. Almost a gram of pure white crystals, which were in an airtight metal vial with a rubber seal, stored in the freezer. I've attempted to smoke it twice with no result, and haven't been able to find any definitive information regarding oral dosing.
T + 0:00. 150 mg (2 dropper-fulls) of a harmaline tincture mixed in a little ginger ale. Didn't taste too bad.
T + 0:20. 75 mg of harmaline. About 5 minutes later, 80 mg DMT crystals mixed with a little soda. Most of it dissolved.
T + 0:40? Not feeling anything yet. Took 75 mg harmaline and 50 mg DMT the same way as before.
My memory gets hazy at the peak, and I lost track of the time, but shortly after taking the second dose, I noticed the first effect -- a feeling like my spine was swaying forward and back. I lay down and closed my eyes, and started having visions, almost like dreaming while I was awake. Similar to what I'd experienced on LSD but more vivid. I don't remember what I saw.
My mind was empty of all thought. I was simply an observer. When I opened my eyes, the colors in the room were incredibly vivid, blending into each other. I closed my eyes again and heard all kinds of sounds, and just listened, mind still clear of thought. Soon, I felt vibrations along my nerves and all the sounds were replaced with the sound of ringing bells, which I could feel as the vibrations. I felt like my consciousness was traveling along the nerves.
I kept my eyes closed and was completely immersed in the experience until it gradually faded and I fell asleep.
